rationale.text: No element carries a language indication, and the only text in the page is inside an editable box (contenteditable), which holds what a visitor typed. By the wording the html element has no indication; whether the text of an editable box is a text element of the page, or only a field's value, is not settled by the wording. Under the record (Q60, item 2) that text is a field's value, so it is not a witness and cannot ground a fault. The custom check therefore finds no uncovered witness and answers cannot_tell (step 4: the only text without a language source is a field's value); only the record supports this branch, and the tool leaves it to a human. Before the builder's fix the code may take the text as a witness and fault, so this case may not match the current code. axe's html-has-lang faults through an evidence-only link, so the reason at full is alternative_unresolved; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée sur chaque élément de texte ou sur l’un des éléments parents.
